titulo: Trump is hailing his new deal with Greenland and Denmark — but a deal already existed. So what changed?
cuerpo: U.S. President Donald Trump signed a new security agreement with the leaders of Denmark and Greenland on Tuesday. But the U.S. already had a security arrangement with the two parties dating back 75 years. So what's changed? Observers say moderate improvements in the new deal have come at an immense cost.
